_about: Local knowledge base of service-quality dimensions used by Agent 1 (EGSQUAL lookup tool). The dimensions are ADAPTED for e-government mobile services from E-S-QUAL / E-RecS-QUAL (Parasuraman, Zeithaml & Malhotra, 2005) and e-GovQual (Papadomichelaki & Mentzas, 2012). IMPORTANT: verify these definitions against the exact EGSQUAL source cited in your thesis and edit this file if needed - the code reads dimension keys, names and keywords from here, so no code change is required.

EFFICIENCY.definition: The ease and speed with which beneficiaries can access the app, navigate it and complete a task with minimal effort (clear steps, intuitive interface, quick access).
example_issues: Too many steps to log in

SYSTEM_AVAILABILITY.definition: The correct technical functioning of the app: it opens, stays up, does not freeze or crash, authentication and verification codes work, and error messages do not prevent use.

FULFILLMENT.definition: The extent to which the digital service is actually delivered as promised: transactions, payments, registrations and requests are completed accurately, and the expected service options exist.
FULFILLMENT.source: E-S-QUAL: Fulfillment; e-GovQual: Reliability (service delivered as promised)
example_issues: Fees paid but registration not completed

PRIVACY_SECURITY.definition: The degree to which the app is safe and protects beneficiaries' personal and financial information, and beneficiaries trust it with their data.

RESPONSIVENESS.definition: Effective handling of beneficiaries' problems, complaints and reports: timely responses, follow-up, and transparency about the outcome.
example_issues: No response from the complaints team

CONTACT.definition: Availability of channels to reach the service provider (in-app support, phone, chat, complaint form) and the ability to talk to a person when needed.

INFORMATION_QUALITY.definition: Accuracy, completeness, clarity and currency of the information and content shown in the app, including correct language/localisation and up-to-date data.
